title: Compute the second Veronese surface's graded Betti table

source.citation: Wouter Castryck, Filip Cools, Jeroen Demeyer, and Alexander Lemmens, Computing graded Betti tables of toric surfaces, arXiv:1606.08181

translation.notes: The classical six-quadratic determinantal presentation of the second Veronese surface is entered explicitly. Noether certifies the minimal resolution and reproduces the appendix's Betti table. The source's main sixth-Veronese computation remains a scale-blocked case.
